description.value: Denny's is a Canadian chain diner operated under Northland Properties, serving all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a family-friendly sit-down format. The Abbotsford Mt. Lehman location sits near the Trans-Canada corridor, making it a predictable and reliable meal stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley. The extensive menu includes slams, omelettes, burgers, and bowl-style dishes with options across all meal periods.
